meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Review changed code (diff, files, or directory) against layered, stack-aware checklists plus plan- and lesson-aware dynamic checks. Stateless side-skill — chat-only output, no plan-lifecycle status, no persistent report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码变更，确保质量与规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前获得结构化审查反馈
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes for quality and standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured review feedback before merging code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审查你指定的代码变更（如 Git diff、文件或目录），并对照分层检查清单和项目经验给出评审意见。
howto.when: 当你要求审查代码变更，并提供 Git diff 范围、文件路径或目录时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 Git diff。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码差异并给出建议。

say.text: 审查 src/ 目录下的所有改动。
say.note: Claude 会检查该目录的变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews specified code changes (e.g., Git diff, files, or directory) against layered checklists and project-aware dynamic checks, outputting review comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review code changes, providing a Git diff range, file path, or directory.

say_en.text: Review this Git diff for me.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the diff and gives suggestions.

say_en.text: Review all changes in the src/ directory.
say_en.note: Claude checks changes in that directory.
